title: Example Talk: Measuring Mood With A Phone

segments.text: Welcome. Today we are going to walk through how a study measures mood using a phone, and what the data looks like when it comes back.
A daily survey is the simplest instrument. It asks the same few questions at the same time each day, so answers can be compared across weeks.
Passive sensing is the other half. Step count, screen time, and sleep estimates arrive without anybody answering anything.
Together they give two views of the same week. When the two disagree, that disagreement is usually the interesting part of the record.
